editionLabel: dV Giochi Italian base-game rules, English summary
firstPlayerRule: The dealer asks the first question, addressing another player by name.
houseFallback: If your group needs a way to choose the first dealer, agree to pick randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Setup assigns one player to deal but gives no criterion for choosing the initial dealer.
The player who answers asks the next question. They cannot immediately question the person who just asked them.
